notes.text: An abyssal demon or Abyssal Sire Slayer assignment is required.
For fairy ring DIP, bring a dramen or lunar staff unless you have the elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary.
A hydra or Alchemical Hydra Slayer assignment is required.
Wear boots of stone, boots of brimstone or granite boots on the walk through Karuulm to the boss.
Heat protection is not needed after the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary.
Wear a nose peg or Slayer helmet to prevent their stat-draining attack.
The selected Slayer Tower route requires Priest in Peril.
Equip a mirror shield or V's shield to protect against the basilisk gaze.
Bring dragonfire protection, such as an anti-dragon shield, if fighting within melee range.
For the selected Taverley route, bring a dusty key or use the 70 Agility shortcut.
The selected Slayer Tower route requires Priest in Peril.
Bring dragonfire protection; brutal dragons can use dragonfire even at range.
An antifire potion with Protect from Magic protects against regular dragonfire.
Bring weapons for at least two combat styles and switch when its protection prayer changes.
A hellhound or Cerberus Slayer assignment is required.
For the selected Taverley route, bring a dusty key or use the 70 Agility shortcut.
For the selected Brimhaven route, bring an axe and 875 coins unless your entry fee is already covered.
Cutting the Brimhaven vines requires 10 Woodcutting.
Bring a rock hammer, rock thrownhammer or granite hammer for the finishing blow.
Wear a nose peg or Slayer helmet while passing the spectres on the way upstairs.
The selected Slayer Tower route requires Priest in Peril.
The selected Catacombs route is multicombat; a cannon cannot be used there.
A gargoyle or Grotesque Guardians Slayer assignment is required.
Unlock the Slayer Tower roof with a brittle key before your first attempt.
Bring a rock hammer, rock thrownhammer or granite hammer for the finishing blow.
Bring melee plus ranged or magic equipment; Dawn cannot be reached with melee, while Dusk requires melee damage.
The selected Catacombs route is multicombat; a cannon cannot be used there.
Use leaf-bladed weaponry, broad arrows, broad bolts or Magic Dart; other attacks cannot damage kurasks.
A cave kraken or Kraken Slayer assignment is required.
Bring magic equipment; melee cannot reach the Kraken and ranged damage is heavily reduced.
Fishing explosives are recommended to wake the Kraken without a ranged weapon switch.
Wear the full tier 5 Shayzien set to block poison spit.
Antipoison is recommended for the Molch temple fight.
After the hard Kourend & Kebos Diary, Captain Cleive can let your Slayer helmet replace the Shayzien helmet.
Equip an elemental shield, mind shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward or ancient wyvern shield to reduce icy breath damage.
A regular anti-dragon shield and antifire potions do not protect against icy breath.
Bring a lit sapphire lantern for the Tears of Guthix approach, or use a Guthixian temple teleport.
Bring weapons for two combat styles to attack around the demon's protection prayers.
Wear boots of stone, boots of brimstone or granite boots inside Karuulm.
Heat protection is not needed after the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary.
A Slayer boost can meet the 62 Slayer requirement; keep the boost active while fighting.
